_comment: FinePrint on ECS Fargate — the wall baked into the task image.
UNVERIFIED (investigation doc §7.3): whether `unshare` works inside
a Fargate task container is unverified — no source confirms or denies
it — and Fargate gives you NO knob to turn: no privileged containers,
only CAP_SYS_PTRACE addable, no seccomp=unconfined. Run the wall's
smoke test as a Fargate task first (cloud/nested-unshare-test.sh,
adapted to a task). If it fails, Fargate cannot run the wall, full
stop — there is nothing to relax.
Notes:
- Replace ACCOUNT_ID / REGION and the secret ARNs. Never put a key
in `environment` — use Secrets Manager (shown) or SSM Parameter
Store, and give the task role read access to it.
- `command` is the agent command (the image's ENTRYPOINT is the
gate, so ["claude"] runs `fineprint gate run -- claude`).
- The task needs a VPC with egress for the agent's API calls; the
wall's egress proxy controls what the agent can reach in deny
mode, and confine mode with no hosts allowlisted gives it no
network at all. The agent's API host must be reachable or the
agent cannot work.
- The audit log: set FINEPRINT_LOG to a path inside the container
and ship it to CloudWatch (see logConfiguration) or an EFS
volume if you want the log out. Without it, the log is not
written and the run leaves no audit trail.
- The image is NOT published anywhere yet — push it to your own
ECR repository first (no GHCR / Docker Hub push).
